key_findings: Intraplantar TNF-alpha, CXCL1, IL-1beta, NE and PGE2 induce hyperalgesia in mice.
Opioid antagonists potentiated and bestatin reduced hyperalgesia, indicating endogenous peripheral opioid control triggered by cytokines.
